+"""Targeted test for retrieval.adaptive parsing in load_config.
+
+Generated by the deterministic codegen handler for the
+``config-parsing-test-add`` eval task. Kept narrow: a single function with
+the substring ``adaptive_flag`` so ``pytest -k adaptive_flag`` selects it.
+"""
+
+import tempfile
+
+from code_rag.experiments.config import load_config
+
+
+def test_adaptive_flag_is_parsed():
+    yaml_content = (
+        "name: codegen_adaptive_flag\n"
+        "repo_path: /tmp/repo\n"
+        "retrieval:\n"
+        "  adaptive: true\n"
+    )
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
+        mode="w", suffix=".yaml", delete=False
+    ) as f:
+        f.write(yaml_content)
+        f.flush()
+        config = load_config(f.name)
+    assert config.retrieval.adaptive is True
